title: fix(formula)!: the gate refuses a date field handed straight to a call that takes a timestamp, which faulted on every record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMBoDrtWP5sxGnLUSPdsAt3)_

Fixes #32595

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the author-time gate (`os validate`, `os build`, `os lint`, the object save door and the other doors of the active authoring gate) refuses a call on a date or datetime field it passed before. The two refusals it drops (concatenating a date field with text, ordering one against a text literal) are behaviour the published text already declares accepted: the `registerDateTextOverloads` docblock in `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` ("ordering against another date field or a text literal → string-lex", "`+` with text … → string concatenation") and this package's 18.3.0 changelog entry for #28944 (51058ef: "Date comparisons (`<`, `==`, against a literal, against `today()`), concatenation, … all stay accepted"). Nothing is newly accepted.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #32818

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：日期、日期时间字段直接交给只收时间戳的函数（`isoDate(record.start_at)`、`record.start_date.getFullYear()`），编写期现在直接拒绝，并给出改写 `isoDate(date(record.start_at))`；日期字段和文本拼接、和文本字面量比较，不再误拒。
- 为什么改：运行期日期字段是文本，编写期却按时间戳检查，所以这类表达式过了所有检查，上线后每条记录都出错：公式读成空，校验规则拒掉每一次写入。
- 风险与回滚：收窄拒的是字段以文本到达就出错的写法（SQL 读门、JSON 写入下，值到达调用的每条记录都出错，带守卫的调用也一样拒）；datetime 以 JS Date 到达时（服务端写入方、MongoDB 读出）这类写法能求值，同样被拒，但给出的改写在两种形态下读出同一个值。第一方调用方 0（全量 dogfood 见下方）。撤掉的两处误拒都有已发布文本写明「接受」，逐条引在正文里；与非字面量文本比较、以及读了宏绑定变量的比较，仍保持原判。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` 的 `firstDateTextCall`、`confirmAgainstDateText` 和 `comparesDateTextAgainstUndeclared`，再看 `packages/formula/src/validate.ts` 的 `dateTextCallIssue`，最后看台账条目 `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.formula-date-text-call-refused.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts`，应看到 66 个全过，其中双判表每一行同时核对门禁的结论和求值器的实际结果。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The type-soundness gate (`validateExpression` in `@objectstack/formula`) typed a `date` / `datetime` field as a CEL Timestamp. The runtime never holds one: every read door serves a date field as its `YYYY-MM-DD` text and a datetime field as its ISO-8601 instant text. So `isoDate(record.start_at)` checked clean and then faulted on every record (`found no matching overload for 'isoDate(string)'`). The lane fix is on the authoring side, as the seat agreed: the runtime binding stays as it is.

1. **A call on a date field's text is refused (the narrowing).** `firstDateTextCall` (cel-engine.ts) re-checks the expression with only the date fields typed as their text (`TemporalTyping` `'text'`; every other field `dyn`). For each call or method call that is handed a date field directly and that the text typing refuses with cel-js's `no_matching_overload` code, it builds the call with the field wrapped in `date(…)`, checks that rewrite clean, and only then reports it. `validate.ts` `dateTextCallIssue` turns that into the new refusal `date-text-call` (or `-fail-closed`, `-fail-open`, `-run-fails`, `-run-may-fail` where the site's fault outcome is known), `severity: error`, `params: { call, reference, rewrite }`. The check runs only where the existing date-text check found no arithmetic fault, so a date-arithmetic expression keeps its existing refusal word for word.
2. **Two misrefusals are dropped (returning to declared behaviour, not new acceptance).** `firstTypeMismatch` now confirms a Timestamp-typed text/boolean mismatch against the date-text typing (`confirmAgainstDateText`) before reporting it. Concatenating a date field with text and ordering one against a text literal evaluate to a value at runtime, and the published text says they are accepted, so they are clean now. A comparison (`<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `==`, `!=`) of a date field's text is dropped only when the other operand is a text literal, another date field, a Timestamp or `null`. Those are the counterparts the declared text names. `comparesDateTextAgainstUndeclared` reads each operand's type from the date-text typing by checking that operand on its own. Any other text counterpart keeps the `type-mismatch` verdict it had on base. That covers a text field read directly (`record.title < record.start_at`) or through a ternary, and text computed by `+`, `upper(…)`, `string(…)` or `isoDate(…)`. A comparison whose operand reads a variable bound by a macro (`all`, `exists`, `exists_one`, `map`, `filter`) also keeps its verdict, in the record scope and in the flattened one, where such a variable is `dyn` and proves nothing.
3. **The upgrade guide entry** `formula-date-text-call-refused` (ADR-0087 semantic migration) rides this PR, with an `@objectstack/spec` patch in the same changeset.

### Moved answers (FROM → TO), measured on base `ee230a25` vs this head through `validateExpression`

| # | Expression (site) | FROM (base) | TO (head) | Arm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `isoDate(record.start_time)` (formula) | clean | error `date-text-call` | narrowing |
| 2 | `isoDatetime(record.start_time)` (formula) | clean | error `date-text-call` | narrowing |
| 3 | `!startsWith(isoDate(record.start_time), '2026')` (validation rule) | clean | error `date-text-call-fail-closed` | narrowing |
| 4 | `record.start_time.getFullYear() == 2026` (validation rule) | clean | error `date-text-call-fail-closed` | narrowing |
| 5 | `record.title + ' ' + record.start_time` (formula) | warning `type-mismatch` | clean | declared (A, B) |
| 6 | `record.title + ' ' + record.start_time != ''` (validation rule) | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | clean | declared (A, B) |
| 7 | `"Due: " + record.end_day`, `record.end_day + " (due)"` (formula) | warning `type-mismatch` | clean | declared (A, B) |
| 8 | `record.start_day < "2026-12-01"`, `"2026-01-01" <= record.start_time` (validation rule) | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | clean | declared (A, B) |
| 9 | `record.start_day < "2026-12-01"` (formula, or a predicate with no outcome) | warning `type-mismatch` | clean | declared (A, B) |
| 10 | `record.title < record.start_time` (validation rule) | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | unchanged | — |
| 11 | `record.start_day < (record.flag ? record.title : record.other)` | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | unchanged | — |
| 12 | `(record.flag ? record.start_day : record.end_day) < record.title` | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | unchanged | — |
| 13 | `record.start_day < record.title + 'x'` | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | unchanged | — |
| 14 | `record.start_day < upper(record.title)` | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | unchanged | — |
| 15 | `record.start_day < string(record.amount)` | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | unchanged | — |
| 16 | `record.start_day < isoDate(today())` | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | unchanged | — |
| 17 | `record.start_time != null && isoDate(record.start_time) == '2026-11-16'` (validation rule) | clean | error `date-text-call-fail-closed` | narrowing (guarded call) |
| 18 | `[record.title].exists(x, record.start_day < x)` | error `type-mismatch-fail-closed` | unchanged | — |
| 19 | `[title].exists(x, start_time < x)` (flattened scope, no fault outcome) | warning `type-mismatch-run-may-fail` | unchanged | — |

Rows 1–4 fault on every record whose value reaches the call as text. Row 17 reads `false` on a row without a value and faults on every row with one. Rows 5–16 and 18 evaluate to a value, pinned by the double-judgment table below, which reads `today()` on a fixed clock (`2026-11-12T09:00:00.000Z`). Row 19 is pinned on its own in the flattened test. Equality against a text field (`record.d == record.title`) was clean on base and stays clean.

### Declared text for each dropped refusal

- **(A) The `DATE_TEXT_CEL_TYPE` overload docblock** on `registerDateTextOverloads` in `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`, on main since #28944, lists what the evaluator answers on a date field's text: "ordering against another date field or a text literal → string-lex, and against a Timestamp → the text operand is coerced to a date: `bool`" and "`+` with text, or with another date field's text → string concatenation". It is the table of shapes the gate declares the evaluator answers. On base, the older Timestamp-typed mismatch check (`firstTypeMismatch`) reported rows 5–9 before that table was ever asked; now it asks it first.
- **(B) The #28944 changelog entry** (`packages/formula/CHANGELOG.md`, 18.3.0, 51058ef), its **Unchanged** line: "Date comparisons (`<`, `==`, against a literal, against `today()`), concatenation, `daysBetween` / `addDays`, number arithmetic, and a predicate that compares a duration … all stay accepted."
- Rows 10–16, 18 and 19 are in neither text, so they are not widened here and keep their refusal. These are a date field compared against text that is not a literal (a text field read directly or through a ternary, or computed text), and a comparison that reads a macro-bound variable.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts`, new describe "a date field's text handed to a call, concatenated or ordered against text (#32595)":
  - A double-judgment table (`ROWS`): each row is judged by the gate (errors and warnings, by code) AND by the evaluator over a real row, so a refused row must fault at runtime and a clean row must evaluate to a value. Only an overload fault counts as the row's fault; any other fault (an unbound name) fails the row.
  - The card's rule rewritten as the refusal prescribes passes a 2026 row and refuses a 2025 one.
  - A guarded call (`record.start_time != null && isoDate(record.start_time) == …`) is refused. It reads `false` on a row without a value and faults on a row with one; its rewrite keeps the guard and reads `true`.
  - Where a date-time arrives as a JS `Date`, the refused call evaluates. Each prescribed rewrite (`isoDate`, `isoDatetime`, `getFullYear()`, `getHours()` over `date(…)`) reads the same value on the `Date` row as on the text row.
  - The double-judgment table evaluates on a fixed clock (`now: 2026-11-12T09:00:00.000Z`), so the `today()` rows read the same value on any day.
  - In the flattened scope, `[title].exists(x, start_time < x)` keeps its `type-mismatch-run-may-fail` warning, because the macro variable is `dyn`.
  - The refusal's params and message, a fault met first does not mask the call, the flattened (flow) codes with the row bound through `extra`, and no check without field types.
- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: exact-message pins for the five new codes, and two new sweep sources.

## Acceptance notes

- **Declared side.** The runtime's text binding is the declared side (every read door, ADR-0053 D-F1), so the fix is on the authoring side and the runtime is untouched.
- **Reach where a date-time arrives as a JS `Date` (contract review should-fix 3).** D-F1 and ruling 5507803003 govern `@objectstack/driver-sql`. This was measured through the engine, using `ObjectQL` with a stub driver and the validation rule `isoDate(record.at) != '2026-11-16'`. A writer handing `new Date('2026-11-16T01:00:00Z')` reaches the rule as a `Date`, and the rule evaluates: it accepts on that day and fires on another. The same instant handed as ISO text faults (`could not be evaluated … write rejected`). The rewritten rule `isoDate(date(record.at)) != '2026-11-16' || date(record.at).getHours() != 1` accepts both shapes on that instant and fires on both on another day. `driver-mongodb` stores `Field.datetime` as a BSON `Date` (`storageDatetimeValue`), and its read path carries no text presentation, so a MongoDB read hands the evaluator a `Date`. This was **not measured end to end**: `mongodb-memory-server` downloads its binary from `fastdl.mongodb.org`, which this container's network policy refuses (`CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`). On MongoDB, `Field.date` is stored as `YYYY-MM-DD` text (`storageDateValue`). So where a datetime arrives as a `Date`, the gate refuses a call that evaluates, and the prescribed rewrite reads the same value on both shapes.
- **Residual, not reported by the new check.** A call handed a date field's text through `coalesce`, a ternary branch, or a comprehension variable is not reported by the call check, because the check asks only about a call that is handed the field directly. The gate stays as it was for those shapes (no new false refusal).
- **Out of scope, found while measuring (class a).** `isoDate(record.<text field>)` also passes the gate and faults at runtime on any row. It is the same fault class, but a text field is not this card's date binding, and the new check asks only about date fields.
- **Out of scope, wording.** The `type-mismatch` message for a Timestamp counterpart (`record.title < today()`) says "against a number".
- **Branch.** `claude/project-thread-hgwmfi` is a harness branch of the card thread, not `claude/issue-…`.
